waveai@crowe-account.display:name: Crowe account
waveai@crowe-account.display:description: Connect your Crowe account. Uses the default model included in your plan, with tools. No API key required. Each model request, including tool follow-ups, counts toward your plan limit.

waveai@crowelm-supreme.display:description: Advanced API-key setup for long-context research and reasoning, with tools. Requires a separate model API key; account sign-in does not configure this mode.

waveai@crowelm-apex.display:name: CroweLM Code
waveai@crowelm-apex.display:description: Advanced API-key setup for implementation, refactors, tests, and reviews, with tools. Requires a separate model API key; account sign-in does not configure this mode.

waveai@crowelm-auto.display:name: CroweLM Workspace
waveai@crowelm-auto.display:description: Advanced API-key setup for general workspace tasks, with tools. Requires a separate model API key; choose Crowe account for account-based access.

waveai@azure-luna.display:name: CroweLM Luna

waveai@azure-zenith.display:name: CroweLM Zenith
